```lean
CategoryTheory.monoidalOfHasFiniteProducts.{v, u} (C : Type u) [Category.{v, u} C] [HasTerminal C]
  [HasBinaryProducts C] : MonoidalCategory C
```
***
A category with a terminal object and binary products has a natural monoidal structure. 
***
*import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.OfHasFiniteProducts*

```lean
CategoryTheory.monoidalOfHasFiniteProducts.associator_hom.{v, u} (C : Type u) [Category.{v, u} C] [HasTerminal C]
  [HasBinaryProducts C] (X Y Z : C) :
  (α_ X Y Z).hom = prod.lift (prod.fst ≫ prod.fst) (prod.lift (prod.fst ≫ prod.snd) prod.snd)
```
***
*import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.OfHasFiniteProducts*

```lean
CategoryTheory.monoidalOfHasFiniteProducts.associator_inv.{v, u} (C : Type u) [Category.{v, u} C] [HasTerminal C]
  [HasBinaryProducts C] (X Y Z : C) :
  (α_ X Y Z).inv = prod.lift (prod.lift prod.fst (prod.snd ≫ prod.fst)) (prod.snd ≫ prod.snd)
```
***
*import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.OfHasFiniteProducts*

```lean
CategoryTheory.NatIso.ofComponents.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂}
  [Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {F G : C ⥤ D} (app : (X : C) → F.obj X ≅ G.obj X)
  (naturality : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y), F.map f ≫ (app Y).hom = (app X).hom ≫ G.map f := by aesop_cat) : F ≅ G
```
***
Construct a natural isomorphism between functors by giving object level isomorphisms,
and checking naturality only in the forward direction.

***
*import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.NatIso*

```lean
iso_cartesianComon_.{v, u} {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C] [HasTerminal C] [HasBinaryProducts C] (A : Comon_ C) :
  A ≅ (cartesianComon_ C).obj A.X
```
***
Every comonoid object in a cartesian monoidal category is equivalent to
the canonical comonoid structure on the underlying object.
